title: BENCHMARKING OPEN-SOURCE LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS FOR PERSIAN IN ZERO-SHOT AND FEW-SHOT LEARNING
reasoning: The paper benchmarks several Large Language Models on the Persian MMLU dataset, which specifically includes 'Theology' (LPS, UPS, and LSS) and 'Philosophy' as subject categories for performance evaluation. These categories are featured prominently in Tables 9, 10, 11, and 12, and are discussed in the results and analysis sections.
